  • Field Details

    • where

      public final String where
      The location where the exception occurs.

      The location is provided through the where parameter of the handle methods in SwallowedExceptionHandleUtils.

    • index

      public final int index
      The 0-based index of the input CompletionStage that throws the exception.

    • exception

      public final Throwable exception
      The exception.

    • attachment

      @Nullable public final Object attachment
      An optional attachment object that may contain additional context; can be null.

      The attachment object is provided through the attachments parameter of the handle methods in SwallowedExceptionHandleUtils.
